UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE
LOCATION WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A
MEETING: YOU MAY ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov,
OR JOIN THE ZOOM MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE
FOLLOWING LINK: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/7095732685; MEETING ID: 709 573 2685. THE MEETING
MAY BE VIEWED THROUGH ZOOM, FIOS CHANNEL 32 OR CHARTER CHANNEL 3, OR ON THE CITY'S

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the
City Council beginning at 6:00 PM on May 30, 2023 in the City Council Chambers, Norwalk City Hall, 12700
Norwalk Boulevard. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

(Members of the public are entitled to speak only on the item listed. Please fill out a speaker card and turn it
in to the Sergeant at Arms before the meeting commences.)

 CALL TO ORDER/FLAG SALUTE

  Mayor Valencia

 ROLL CALL

  Theresa Devoy, CMC
  City Clerk

 REPORT

  FISCAL YEAR 2023/24 PROPOSED BUDGET
  The Fiscal Year 2023/24 Proposed Budget is presented for discussion and direction.
 ADJOURNMENT

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City
Hall not less than 24-hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City
Council and to the following newspapers: Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and
Whittier Daily News, all on May 25, 2023.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk

Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after
it has been posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council on any matter listed on the agenda.

Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate
in a City meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720.
Assisted listening devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device.
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability. Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time
when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to
provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
   City Council Agenda Report
  May 30, 2023

TO:  Honorable City Council

FROM:  Jesus M. Gomez, City Manager

BY:  Jana Stuard, Director of Finance/City Treasurer

SUBJECT: FISCAL YEAR 2023/24 PROPOSED BUDGET

Background:

Each year the City is required by the Norwalk Municipal Code to prepare an annual budget and
present it to City Council for public consideration. The proposed budget for the upcoming fiscal
year, which covers the period July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024, was presented to the Finance Ad
Hoc Committee on May 11, 2023 and distributed to the members of City Council on May 19. The
document was also made available for public review in the City Clerk’s Department and on the
City’s web page.

The Fiscal Year (FY) 2023/24 Proposed Budget contains the following sections:
  Summaries:
   Changes to Fund Balances/Working Capital
   Inter-Fund Transfers
   All Funds – Expenditure Summary
   All Funds – Full Time Positions and Part Time Hours
   General Fund Revenue Summary
   General Fund Expenditure Summaries by Type and Function
  Revenues – all funds
  Capital Outlays
  Capital Projects – carryover and new projects.
  Departmental Detail – contains the following information for each departmental division
  (Budget Unit):
   Organizational Chart – represents organizational structure of each department
   Personnel Information – summarizes budgeted full-time positions and part-time
  hours.
   Activities and Objectives
 City Council  May 30, 2023
Fiscal Year 2023/24 Proposed Budget  Page No. 2

   Activity Detail – contains the explanation and/or the breakdown of certain
  expenditure line items, such as: contract services, membership, special
  studies, special projects, etc.
   Departmental Expenditure Budget – details line items per Budget Unit.

The FY 2023/24 Budget is balanced by using the City’s available resources, including the last
allocation of American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) revenues available to offset General Fund loss
of revenues caused by the recent COVID-19 pandemic. For the upcoming fiscal year the
funding of the Homeless Outreach activities has been shifted to ARPA. The available General
Fund balance is used to replenish the City’s capital reserves, primarily Technology Upgrades,
Parks Renovation, Building Renovation, and Street Renovation funds.

Subsequent to City Council direction at this and following budget review meetings, a final budget
will be prepared and submitted for adoption at a public hearing scheduled for a meeting in June.

Fiscal Impact:

Contingent on City Council’s direction, the proposed budget, when adopted, will serve as the
City’s expenditure plan for a one-year period, covering July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2024.

Citizens Advised:

Draft Budget on file in the City Clerk’s Office and published on the City’s web page,
link https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/departments/finance/budget.

Strategic Plan 2021 Implementation:

The recommended action adheres to the City’s values to be fiscally responsible, ethical, and
transparent in City’s stewardship; and it will further the City’s Strategic Plan Goal (3) Maintain
strong local tax base to support City operations.

Recommended Action:

The Fiscal Year 2023/24 Proposed Budget is presented for discussion and direction.
